summary: Excellent PowerShell and GitHub Actions conventions: Set-StrictMode, $ErrorActionPreference='Stop', [CmdletBinding()], ValidateSet, proper exit codes (0/1/2), least-privilege permissions, actionable error messages. CRITICAL: Missing `fixtures/secrets.json` (env CONFIG_PATH, line ~27) — workflow will fail immediately at 'Render markdown report' step without it. Minor inefficiency: 'Emit machine-readable summary' calls script 3 times total (1 markdown + 1 JSON + 1 markdown) when output could be consolidated. Module design is excellent (pure functions, isolated I/O, testable).
